observationGrain: One completed NFL game, designated home and away teams

sourceTargets.home_score: Schedule final home score in points, including overtime
sourceTargets.away_score: Schedule final away score in points, including overtime

labelAvailability: Only after game completion. Historical Gold requires game_state=FINAL. Label release vintages are not available; historical features use strict prior completed GAME DATE, excluding all target-date outcomes.
parameterization: Two separately fitted score regressors sharing a fold-local preprocessing contract. NOT direct margin/total regression and NOT a three-class classifier.
transformations: No logarithm or other target transformation. Predicted team means are clipped at zero before distribution construction.

loss.XGBoost: reg:squarederror independently for home and away scores
loss.HGB: squared_error independently for home and away scores

derivedQuantities.margin: home_points - away_points; positive means home advantage
derivedQuantities.probabilities: Joint-distribution mass where home score is less than, equal to, or greater than away score; not training targets of the score regressors

distribution.law: Paired centered empirical residuals from chronological training-only calibration games, added to nonnegative score means, clipped at zero, stochastically rounded to integer points. Sampling preserves residual pair dependence.
distribution.meanDistinction: Clipping and finite Monte Carlo draws can make distribution expectations differ from fitted regressor means. Published forecast summaries refer to the actual persisted distribution.
limitations: Integerization is not a sequential football scoring model and can assign implausible low score combinations
Final tie mass does not identify regulation tie or overtime-entry probability
No drive, player, route or tackle path is implied
distribution.calibration: Raw joint distribution and separately calibrated class probabilities must keep separate identities unless the adjusted full joint distribution is evaluated and republished coherently.

populations.postseason: Included with explicit game_type category WC/DIV/CON/SB; different overtime termination rules. Targets remain final scores including overtime. No postseason target transform.
populations.preseason: Separate, not part of the 6991-game Development experiment

operationalModel.warning: Operational M1 includes 2025 training. It is not an unbiased historical baseline on those training games. Development comparisons use saved fold-refitted M1 recipe OOF, not operational in-sample predictions.

executableLocations: server/sports_nfl/canonical.py: _specs and materialize_canonical_silver schedule score casts
server/sports_nfl/gold.py: final-score labels and strict prior-date history SQL
server/sports_nfl_m1/benchmark.py: score fitting and chronological residual calibration
